<![CDATA[export type SpectralPresetId =
  | "solar-flare"
  | "deep-borealis"
  | "liquid-mercury"
  | "neochrome-velvet"
  | "supernova";

export interface SpectralPreset {
  id: SpectralPresetId;
  name: string;
  subtitle: string;
  wavelengthNm: number;
  abbeVd: number;
  refractiveIndex: number;
  turbulence: number;
  flowVelocity: number;
  chromaticSpread: number;
  /** Normalized RGB vectors [r, g, b] (0..1) for WebGL uniforms */
  uniformStops: [
    [number, number, number],
    [number, number, number],
    [number, number, number],
    [number, number, number]
  ];
  hexStops: [string, string, string, string];
  cssGradient: string;
  description: string;
}

export const SPECTRAL_PRESETS: Record<SpectralPresetId, SpectralPreset> = {
  "solar-flare": {
    id: "solar-flare",
    name: "Solar Flare",
    subtitle: "589nm · Sodium D-Line",
    wavelengthNm: 589,
    abbeVd: 54.2,
    refractiveIndex: 1.618,
    turbulence: 1.1,
    flowVelocity: 0.8,
    chromaticSpread: 0.45,
    uniformStops: [
      [0.04, 0.04, 0.06], // deep obsidian base
      [0.08, 0.09, 0.14], // deep smoked glass
      [0.72, 0.22, 0.06], // rich amber vermilion
      [0.0, 0.65, 0.78],  // luminous cyan corona
    ],
    hexStops: ["#0A0B10", "#141724", "#FF4D00", "#00F0FF"],
    cssGradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0A0B10 0%, #141724 45%, #FF4D00 78%, #00F0FF 100%)",
    description: "High-temperature coronal discharge. Dense amber and vermilion caustics bordered by an energetic cyan ionizing fringe.",
  },
  "deep-borealis": {
    id: "deep-borealis",
    name: "Deep Borealis",
    subtitle: "532nm · Auroral Viridian",
    wavelengthNm: 532,
    abbeVd: 68.4,
    refractiveIndex: 1.542,
    turbulence: 0.85,
    flowVelocity: 0.6,
    chromaticSpread: 0.38,
    uniformStops: [
      [0.03, 0.05, 0.08], // deep subarctic night
      [0.06, 0.10, 0.15], // subarctic slate
      [0.0, 0.65, 0.52],  // auroral viridian
      [0.0, 0.55, 0.85],  // cryogenic cyan
    ],
    hexStops: ["#070D14", "#0F1A26", "#00F0B3", "#00C0FF"],

<![CDATA[import { SPECTRAL_PRESETS, type SpectralPreset, type SpectralPresetId } from "./presets";
import { calculateCameraOrbit, type CameraOrbitState } from "./physics";

export interface SpectralStoreState {
  activePresetId: SpectralPresetId;
  dispersion: number;
  turbulence: number;
  flowVelocity: number;
  chromaticSpread: number;
  scrollProgress: number;
  pointer: { x: number; y: number; vx: number; vy: number };
  cameraOrbit: CameraOrbitState;
  reducedMotion: boolean;
  prismYaw: number;
  prismPitch: number;
  version: number;
}

type Listener = () => void;

export class SpectralStore {
  private state: SpectralStoreState;
  private listeners: Set<Listener> = new Set();

  constructor(initialPreset: SpectralPresetId = "solar-flare") {
    const preset = SPECTRAL_PRESETS[initialPreset];
    this.state = {
      activePresetId: initialPreset,
      dispersion: preset.refractiveIndex,
      turbulence: preset.turbulence,
      flowVelocity: preset.flowVelocity,
      chromaticSpread: preset.chromaticSpread,
      scrollProgress: 0,
      pointer: { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 },
      cameraOrbit: calculateCameraOrbit(0, 0, 0),
      reducedMotion: false,
      prismYaw: -0.28,
      prismPitch: 0.1,
      version: 0,
    };
  }

  public getSnapshot = (): SpectralStoreState => {
    return this.state;
  };

  public subscribe = (listener: Listener): (() => void) => {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  };

  private notify() {
    this.state = { ...this.state, version: this.state.version + 1 };
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      listener();
    }
  }

  public setPreset(id: SpectralPresetId) {
    if (!SPECTRAL_PRESETS[id]) return;
    const preset = SPECTRAL_PRESETS[id];
    this.state = {
      ...this.state,
      activePresetId: id,
      dispersion: preset.refractiveIndex,
      turbulence: preset.turbulence,
      flowVelocity: preset.flowVelocity,
      chromaticSpread: preset.chromaticSpread,
    };
    this.notify();
  }

  public setParameters(params: Partial<{
    dispersion: number;
    turbulence: number;
    flowVelocity: number;
    chromaticSpread: number;
  }>) {
    this.state = {
      ...this.state,
      dispersion: params.dispersion ?? this.state.dispersion,
      turbulence: params.turbulence ?? this.state.turbulence,
      flowVelocity: params.flowVelocity ?? this.state.flowVelocity,
      chromaticSpread: params.chromaticSpread ?? this.state.chromaticSpread,
    };
    this.notify();
  }

  public setPrismOrientation(yaw: number, pitch: number) {
    if (Math.abs(this.state.prismYaw - yaw) < 0.001 && Math.abs(this.state.prismPitch - pitch) < 0.001) return;
    this.state = {
      ...this.state,
      prismYaw: yaw,
      prismPitch: pitch,
    };
    this.notify();
  }

  public setScrollProgress(progress: number) {
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
    if (Math.abs(clamped - this.state.scrollProgress) < 0.001) return;
    const orbit = this.state.reducedMotion
      ? { pitchDeg: 0, yawDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, translationZ: 0, focalDepth: 1.5 }
      : calculateCameraOrbit(clamped, this.state.pointer.x, this.state.pointer.y);

    this.state = {
      ...this.state,
      scrollProgress: clamped,
      cameraOrbit: orbit,
    };
    this.notify();
  }

  public setPointer(x: number, y: number, vx = 0, vy = 0) {
    const orbit = this.state.reducedMotion
      ? { pitchDeg: 0, yawDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, translationZ: 0, focalDepth: 1.5 }
      : calculateCameraOrbit(this.state.scrollProgress, x, y);

    this.state = {
      ...this.state,
      pointer: { x, y, vx, vy },
      cameraOrbit: orbit,
    };
    this.notify();
  }

  public setReducedMotion(reduced: boolean) {
    if (this.state.reducedMotion === reduced) return;
    const orbit = reduced
      ? { pitchDeg: 0, yawDeg: 0, rollDeg: 0, translationZ: 0, focalDepth: 1.5 }
      : calculateCameraOrbit(this.state.scrollProgress, this.state.pointer.x, this.state.pointer.y);

    this.state = {
      ...this.state,
      reducedMotion: reduced,
      cameraOrbit: orbit,
    };
    this.notify();
  }

  public getActivePreset(): SpectralPreset {
    return SPECTRAL_PRESETS[this.state.activePresetId];
  }
}

// Global singleton for the template instance
export const spectralStore = new SpectralStore("solar-flare");

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { spectralStore } from "./spectral-store";
import { PRESET_ORDER, SPECTRAL_PRESETS, type SpectralPresetId } from "./presets";
import { calculateAbbeNumber, calculateFlux, wavelengthToHue } from "./physics";

export function SpectralSynthesizer() {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const storeState = useSyncExternalStore(
    spectralStore.subscribe,
    spectralStore.getSnapshot,
    spectralStore.getSnapshot
  );

  const activePreset = SPECTRAL_PRESETS[storeState.activePresetId];

  // Derived telemetry
  const nF = storeState.dispersion + 0.008 * storeState.chromaticSpread;
  const nC = storeState.dispersion - 0.008 * storeState.chromaticSpread;
  const abbeNumber = calculateAbbeNumber(storeState.dispersion, nF, nC);
  const fluxLm = calculateFlux(storeState.dispersion, activePreset.wavelengthNm);
  const hue = wavelengthToHue(activePreset.wavelengthNm);

  // Dynamic CSS code block
  const generatedCss = `/* IRIDIA Kinetic Gradient Waveform */
.kinetic-gradient {
  background: ${activePreset.cssGradient};
  filter: contrast(${Math.round(100 + storeState.turbulence * 15)}%) saturate(${Math.round(110 + storeState.chromaticSpread * 40)}%);
  animation: iridiaFlow ${Math.max(4, Math.round(16 / storeState.flowVelocity))}s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}`;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatedCss);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2400);
    } catch {
      // Fallback
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2400);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[1400px] mx-auto rounded-lg ir-glass-panel p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-10 relative overflow-hidden" id="synthesizer">
      {/* Background Ambient Spectral Glow */}
      <div
        className="absolute -top-32 -left-32 w-96 h-96 rounded-full blur-[150px] opacity-20 pointer-events-none -z-10"
        style={{
          background: "radial-gradient(circle, #00F0FF 0%, #FFE600 70%, transparent 80%)",
        }}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
      {/* Top Bar: Subtitle & Status */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-6 border-b border-[#8D93A8]/20">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#00F0FF] animate-pulse" />
            <span className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[#00F0FF]">
              Spectral Gradient Synthesizer · v2.4
            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-display text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-[#F5F3EF] mt-1">
            Modulate Optical Waveform
          </h2>
        </div>

        {/* Preset Selector Tabs */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" role="tablist" aria-label="Spectral Presets">
          {PRESET_ORDER.map((id) => {
            const p = SPECTRAL_PRESETS[id];
            const isActive = storeState.activePresetId === id;
            return (
              <button
                key={id}
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={isActive}
                aria-controls="synthesizer-panel"
                onClick={() => spectralStore.setPreset(id)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[#00F0FF] text-[#0A0B10] font-semibold shadow-md shadow-[#00F0FF]/20"
                    : "bg-[#141724]/80 text-[#8D93A8] hover:text-[#F5F3EF] hover:border-[#8D93A8]/40 border border-[#8D93A8]/20"
                }`}
              >
                {p.name}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 pt-6" id="synthesizer-panel">
        {/* Left Column: Sliders */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-5">
          {/* Slider 1: Refractive Index */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs font-mono">
              <label htmlFor="input-dispersion" className="text-[#F5F3EF] flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                Refractive Index <span className="text-[#8D93A8]">(nD)</span>
              </label>
              <span className="text-[#00F0FF] font-bold">{storeState.dispersion.toFixed(3)}</span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="input-dispersion"
              type="range"
              min="1.30"
              max="1.90"
              step="0.005"
              value={storeState.dispersion}
              onChange={(e) => spectralStore.setParameters({ dispersion: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
              className="ir-range"
              aria-valuemin={1.3}
              aria-valuemax={1.9}
              aria-valuenow={storeState.dispersion}
              aria-label="Refractive Index"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8D93A8]">
              <span>1.30 (Fused Silica)</span>
              <span>1.90 (Dense Flint)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slider 2: Turbulence */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs font-mono">
              <label htmlFor="input-turbulence" className="text-[#F5F3EF] flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                Curl Turbulence <span className="text-[#8D93A8]">(∇×u)</span>
              </label>
              <span className="text-[#00F0FF] font-bold">{storeState.turbulence.toFixed(2)}</span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="input-turbulence"
              type="range"
              min="0.30"
              max="2.50"
              step="0.05"
              value={storeState.turbulence}
              onChange={(e) => spectralStore.setParameters({ turbulence: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
              className="ir-range"
              aria-valuemin={0.3}
              aria-valuemax={2.5}
              aria-valuenow={storeState.turbulence}
              aria-label="Curl Turbulence"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8D93A8]">
              <span>0.30 (Laminar)</span>
              <span>2.50 (Vortical)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slider 3: Flow Velocity */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs font-mono">
              <label htmlFor="input-velocity" className="text-[#F5F3EF] flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                Flow Velocity <span className="text-[#8D93A8]">(v)</span>
              </label>
              <span className="text-[#00F0FF] font-bold">{storeState.flowVelocity.toFixed(2)}×</span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="input-velocity"
              type="range"
              min="0.20"
              max="2.20"
              step="0.05"
              value={storeState.flowVelocity}
              onChange={(e) => spectralStore.setParameters({ flowVelocity: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
              className="ir-range"
              aria-valuemin={0.2}
              aria-valuemax={2.2}
              aria-valuenow={storeState.flowVelocity}
              aria-label="Flow Velocity"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8D93A8]">
              <span>0.20× (Glacial)</span>
              <span>2.20× (Accelerated)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slider 4: Chromatic Spread */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs font-mono">
              <label htmlFor="input-spread" className="text-[#F5F3EF] flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                Chromatic Dispersion <span className="text-[#8D93A8]">(Δλ)</span>
              </label>
              <span className="text-[#FF3366] font-bold">{storeState.chromaticSpread.toFixed(2)}</span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="input-spread"
              type="range"
              min="0.10"
              max="1.00"
              step="0.02"
              value={storeState.chromaticSpread}
              onChange={(e) => spectralStore.setParameters({ chromaticSpread: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
              className="ir-range"
              aria-valuemin={0.1}
              aria-valuemax={1.0}
              aria-valuenow={storeState.chromaticSpread}
              aria-label="Chromatic Dispersion"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8D93A8]">
              <span>0.10 (Achromatic)</span>
              <span>1.00 (Prismatic Split)</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Telemetry & Live Distribution */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4">
          {/* Live SVG Spectral Curve */}
          <div className="bg-[#0A0B10]/90 border border-[#8D93A8]/20 rounded-md p-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[#8D93A8] uppercase">
                Spectral Energy Distribution
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#00F0FF]">{activePreset.wavelengthNm} nm</span>
            </div>

            <svg viewBox="0 0 320 90" className="w-full h-24 overflow-visible" aria-label="Spectral curve">
              {/* Grid axes */}
              <line x1="10" y1="80" x2="310" y2="80" stroke="#8D93A8" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeOpacity="0.3" />
              <line x1="10" y1="10" x2="10" y2="80" stroke="#8D93A8" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeOpacity="0.3" />
              
              {/* Dynamic Gaussian curve shifted by wavelength & turbulence */}
              {(() => {
                const center = 10 + ((activePreset.wavelengthNm - 380) / 320) * 300;
                const width = 35 + storeState.chromaticSpread * 45;
                const height = 60 * Math.min(1.2, storeState.dispersion / 1.5);
                const points = [];
                for (let x = 10; x <= 310; x += 10) {
                  const dist = (x - center) / width;
                  const y = 80 - Math.exp(-dist * dist) * height;
                  points.push(`${x},${y.toFixed(1)}`);
                }
                const pathD = `M10,80 L${points.join(" L")} L310,80 Z`;
                return (
                  <>
                    <path d={pathD} fill="url(#spectralGradient)" fillOpacity="0.35" />
                    <path d={`M10,80 L${points.join(" L")}`} fill="none" stroke="#00F0FF" strokeWidth="2" />
                  </>
                );
              })()}

              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="spectralGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#FF3366" />
                  <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#00F0FF" />
                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#FFE600" />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
            </svg>

            {/* Readout tiles */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-[#8D93A8]/15 text-center font-mono">
              <div>
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-[#8D93A8]">ABBE NUMBER</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F5F3EF]">{abbeNumber.toFixed(1)} Vd</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-[#8D93A8]">FLUX DENSITY</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#00F0FF]">{fluxLm} lm/m²</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-[#8D93A8]">HUE ANGLE</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#FFE600]">{Math.round(hue)}°</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Dynamic Code Generator & Copy CTA */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8D93A8] uppercase tracking-wider">
                Exported Gradient Specification
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCopy}
                className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-[#00F0FF] hover:text-[#F5F3EF] transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer bg-[#00F0FF]/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-[#00F0FF]/30"
              >
                {copied ? "✓ Copied to Clipboard" : "Copy CSS Code"}
              </button>
            </div>
            <pre className="bg-[#0A0B10] p-3 rounded border border-[#8D93A8]/20 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8D93A8] overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre">
              <code>{generatedCss}</code>
            </pre>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

`,SR=`#version 300 es
precision highp float;

in vec2 v_uv;
out vec4 fragColor;

uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_resolution;
uniform vec2 u_pointer;
uniform float u_pointer_vel;
uniform float u_turbulence;
uniform float u_flow_velocity;
uniform float u_chromatic_spread;
uniform float u_dispersion;
uniform vec2 u_prism_rot;

uniform vec3 u_stop0;
uniform vec3 u_stop1;
uniform vec3 u_stop2;
uniform vec3 u_stop3;

// Simplex-style 2D noise
vec3 permute(vec3 x) { return mod(((x*34.0)+1.0)*x, 289.0); }

float snoise(vec2 v) {
  const vec4 C = vec4(0.211324865405187, 0.366025403784439,
           -0.577350269189626, 0.024390243902439);
  vec2 i  = floor(v + dot(v, C.yy) );
  vec2 x0 = v -   i + dot(i, C.xx);
  vec2 i1;
  i1 = (x0.x > x0.y) ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : vec2(0.0, 1.0);
  vec4 x12 = x0.xyxy + C.xxzz;
  x12.xy -= i1;
  i = mod(i, 289.0);
  vec3 p = permute( permute( i.y + vec3(0.0, i1.y, 1.0 ))
  + i.x + vec3(0.0, i1.x, 1.0 ));
  vec3 m = max(0.5 - vec3(dot(x0,x0), dot(x12.xy,x12.xy),
    dot(x12.zw,x12.zw)), 0.0);
  m = m*m ;
  m = m*m ;
  vec3 x = 2.0 * fract(p * C.www) - 1.0;
  vec3 h = abs(x) - 0.5;
  vec3 ox = floor(x + 0.5);
  vec3 a0 = x - ox;
  m *= 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * ( a0*a0 + h*h );
  vec3 g;
  g.x  = a0.x  * x0.x  + h.x  * x0.y;
  g.yz = a0.yz * x12.xz + h.yz * x12.yw;
  return 130.0 * dot(m, g);
}

// Curl noise derivation for fluid divergence-free velocity
vec2 curlNoise(vec2 p) {
  float eps = 0.005;
  float n1 = snoise(vec2(p.x, p.y + eps));
  float n2 = snoise(vec2(p.x, p.y - eps));
  float n3 = snoise(vec2(p.x + eps, p.y));
  float n4 = snoise(vec2(p.x - eps, p.y));
  float dx = (n1 - n2) / (2.0 * eps);
  float dy = (n3 - n4) / (2.0 * eps);
  return vec2(dx, -dy);
}

// Sample scalar potential field at given coordinate (smooth, laminar, large-scale)
float sampleField(vec2 uv) {
  float t = u_time * u_flow_velocity * 0.08;
  vec2 p = uv * (0.6 * u_turbulence);
  
  // Smooth, gentle pointer ripple
  vec2 toPointer = uv - u_pointer;
  float pointerDist = length(toPointer);
  float pointerRipple = sin(pointerDist * 4.0 - u_time * 1.5) * exp(-pointerDist * 2.2) * u_pointer_vel * 0.15;
  
  // Broad, silky laminar curl advection (no high-frequency churn)
  vec2 flow = curlNoise(p * 0.75 + vec2(t * 0.1, t * 0.07));
  vec2 p2 = p + flow * 0.3 + pointerRipple;
  
  // Primary smooth wave
  float n1 = snoise(p2 + vec2(t * 0.06, -t * 0.05));
  
  // Gentle harmonic for organic fluid contours
  float n2 = snoise(p2 * 0.8 - vec2(t * 0.08, t * 0.09)) * 0.35;
  
  float raw = (n1 + n2) * 0.45 + 0.5;
  return clamp(raw, 0.0, 1.0);
}

// Interpolate across the 4 spectral stops with generous dark obsidian base
vec3 colorRamp(float t) {
  float s = smoothstep(0.1, 0.9, t);
  if (s < 0.42) {
    float f = s / 0.42;
    return mix(u_stop0, u_stop1, smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, f));
  } else if (s < 0.76) {
    float f = (s - 0.42) / 0.34;
    return mix(u_stop1, u_stop2, smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, f));
  } else {
    float f = (s - 0.76) / 0.24;
    return mix(u_stop2, u_stop3, smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, f));
  }
}

void main() {
  vec2 aspect = vec2(u_resolution.x / u_resolution.y, 1.0);
  vec2 uv = v_uv * aspect;
  
  // Optical origin: screen-space coordinates of the central 3D prism
  vec2 prismOrigin = vec2(0.5 * aspect.x, 0.48);
  vec2 rayVec = uv - prismOrigin;
  float rayDist = length(rayVec);

  // Dynamic Cauchy dispersion angle linked to the 3D prism's yaw & pitch
  float baseAngle = -0.36 + u_prism_rot.x * 0.42;
